date.as_written: samvat 704 caitrakṛṣṇa pañcamyāyāṃ tithau teṣṭanakṣatre, vyatipātajoge yathaṃ karṇṇa(!)madgatre, śanivāsare, mīnarāsigata savitari meṣarāsigate masi

notes: No individual names are mentioned in the colophon. The scribe refers to himself only in the first person ('mama') in the scribal apology verse (jodṛśī pustakaṃ dṛṭvāṃ likhita mama...).
